note: Official public datasets are fetched from the HF mirror and converted to unified task JSONL. Only benchmark data plus evaluation code/protocol/license docs are published; model weights, features and training artifacts are private and are never uploaded.

datasets.name: SpatialMQA
datasets.status: official dev split mirrored (996 images + dev.jsonl + 536 unified tasks); the test split is not published by the authors

datasets.name: Spatial457
datasets.status: official release mirrored (992 images + 3D-asset archive + Spatial457.py generator, Apache 2.0). Unified task conversion is pending: its QA pairs are produced by the official generation pipeline from the 3D assets, so tasks/spatial457.jsonl is not published yet and T2 stays N/A.

datasets.name: MindEdit-Bench
datasets.format: 6 parquet task files, 3-view images embedded; answer = option letter
datasets.status: downloaded + converted (1,003 unified tasks with decoded three-view images)

datasets.name: Spatial-DISE
datasets.format: CSV task tables (dataset/*.csv, DISE-bench/DISE-benchmark.csv) + 16 GB image shards
datasets.status: annotation CSVs mirrored (non-commercial share-alike); 16 GB image shards are download-only

datasets.name: spatial3d (own, diagnostic)
datasets.format: synthetic before/after pairs with structured GT
